% cleveref theorem-name regression guard.
% Independent per-type flat theorem counters (pp-manuscript.sty) must make a
% \cref to a corollary render as "Corollary N", NOT "Theorem N" — the
% shared-counter mislabel the Paper-1 canary fixed. run.sh compiles this,
% runs pdftotext, and asserts the reference line says Corollary.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage[a4paper,margin=30mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{pp-manuscript}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage[capitalise,nameinlink,noabbrev]{cleveref}

\begin{document}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:base}
  A base theorem.
\end{theorem}

\begin{corollary}\label{cor:derived}
  A derived corollary.
\end{corollary}

CREFCHECK: \cref{cor:derived}.

\end{document}
